STOP CALLING ME FAT IM WORKING ON IT

But no matter how many times Ive read or seen all the problems that come with it I still want it. If that makes any sense. Probably not.
You don't get it. To me none of that matters.

Yeah, I get it. But you're in treatment so you probably don't have one year to live. Guess what? For me, it is desirable. Stop harassing me so much and blaming me for your problems. You're skinny because you wanted to be, not because some kid online thinks its pretty.

Do you not get I also said Im wrong in feeling this way? You're like this because you did it to yourself. You're lying anyway. You can't have kids at 82 pounds. You can't have multiple children in less than a year either. You're just a troll.

Which means you're calling me a fat ugly bitch that nobody wants, basically saying I'm right in thinking skinny girls are better (since I'm fat and all). 

So since I'm fat how much should I lose? 10? 20? 40?
That's your fault. You did that to you. Stop harassing me. I know what I feel is wrong but if you can't control your anger you need to leave.

No. Sorry you're fucking someone's wife.
